# Execution Evidence Bridge

> 中文：Execution Evidence Bridge 是一条可运行的 AI Agent 执行证据链：MVK 证明 AI 做过什么，Agent Evidence 把证明打包并验证，Verifiable Agent Demo 给审阅者和 agent 一条最短的跨栈复核路径。

> English: Execution Evidence Bridge is a runnable AI execution evidence path: MVK proves what happened, Agent Evidence packages and verifies the proof, and Verifiable Agent Demo provides the shortest cross-stack verification walkthrough.

中文：
MVK 证明 AI 做过什么；Agent Evidence 把证明打包并验证；Verifiable Agent Demo 提供最短的跨栈复核路径。

English:
MVK proves what happened; Agent Evidence packages and verifies the proof; Verifiable Agent Demo provides the shortest verification walkthrough.
